svg.text: Layout B: GitHub connection panel in Settings, banners link to it
Settings > GitHub gains a Connection block on top: status, a scope checklist (tick or cross, need, what it turns on), the fix command and Check again.
List banners stay short and only link there. The gear and the GitHub nav item carry a ! mark while something is off. On the phone, the link opens the same block as a sheet.
Check again re-reads the token with gh auth token and re-checks X-OAuth-Scopes, no restart.
B1 Desktop 1660x870: required scope missing, Fix in Settings clicked
Settings opens on GitHub. The list behind keeps its short banner.

svg.text: Scope rules: repo and read:org required (sync pauses without them). project optional (issue Status, Move to In progress).
The checklist is also where a working token can be checked any time, not only after a failure.
